## The two universal completion tests

7 October 2026. [Ren requests completion of both remaining achievements](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-complete-mathematical-coverage-and-uniqueness.md): justified generative principles across mathematics, and necessary common constitutive dependence. [The integrated attempt](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ROOT-MATHEMATICAL-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md), affirmative argument, substantive counterreview and focused primary readings directly test those claims. **Neither achievement is completed.** This conclusion concerns the attempted arguments; it does not establish that the full root is false or that metaphysical justification is impossible.

The strongest global candidate examined here adds typed formation, independently specified witness extension, full profile admission, higher levels and interpreted consequence. Full profiles can include non-effective content; stratification need not promise one self-enclosing evaluator. These resources make the proposal substantive, but a global axiom system and its consistency have not been established. The no-arbitrary-exclusion argument warrants respecting an independently admitted full subject. It does not establish that the minimal root requires that subject, its complete profile range or every higher admission. A successful coverage derivation must account for this step.

The necessity argument establishes a requirement to retain the intended mathematical content. A matched structural-modal rival can preserve the same whole, its actual formation, the generated structures and their interpretation, while treating structural admissibility as explaining coherent formation or leaving ultimate priority unsettled. Such a rival incurs the cost of its admission commitments; it is not a certified alternative foundation. Showing that its full explanation expresses the same root dependence would answer the uniqueness question. Agreement on mathematical truths, inseparability of content and articulation, or renaming the rival's resources does not yet show that dependence.

The positive [order result](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ROOT-MATHEMATICAL-COVERAGE-ORDER.md) removes an arbitrary truth-selector premise in a richer language. A seed and before/between/after operations realize every finite order pattern in a supplied dense linear order without endpoints. Rational witnesses implement a Boolean evaluator proved correct for every first-order sentence of pure equality and strict order in that class. The least closure under the chosen operations is elementary. Thirty-three named theorems and 58 declaration audits pass a fresh Lean build. The order axioms remain inputs; arithmetic in the implementation is not an arithmetic symbol in the interpreted language.

The checked [global boundary](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ROOT-MATHEMATICAL-COMPLETION-BOUNDARY.md) excludes a fixed self-indexed representation complete for a family containing its own negated diagonal. Fourteen named theorems and 21 audits also verify larger-domain representation and a new description preserving old meanings. This restricts that precise coverage contract, without excluding external semantics, a hierarchy or the full generative ontology.

**Current mathematical transition:** independently warranted admission and interpretation → all intended mathematical content; then a dependence-preserving explanation shared by every adequate rival. The next substantive advance must derive admission or resolve the explanatory comparison. Another complete local fragment is useful only insofar as it changes those obligations. The existing conditional results and actual scoped counterexamples remain preserved.
